    # Recolor the nonzero shape to 0 and the background using the task's
    # orientation-derived fill color.

    n = len(grid)
    main = all(r == c for r, c in cells)
    anti = all(r + c == n - 1 for r, c in cells)
    fill = 2 if main else 1 if anti else 2
    return [[0 if x else fill for x in row] for row in grid]
